name: FreeScout
description: Built-in self-updater extracts a GitHub zipball directly over the live app, no hash/signature.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: FreeScout builds a GitHub zipball URL, downloads it, and unzips it without an application-level signature/checksum.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | FreeScout | https://github.com/freescout-help-desk/freescout.git | ab2772536811d5de6e23121c5d086aeb50f3db2c / 2026-08-15 | Y (built-in self-updater, customized `codedge/laravel-selfupdater` fork) | N (admin runs `php artisan self-update:update` / clicks Update in admin UI; not scheduled) | Y | https, TLS validation **enforced** (default Guzzle `verify`, no override found) | N | none | none — trust rests entirely on GitHub TLS + `api.github.com` zipball endpoint, unpinned | `overrides/codedge/laravel-selfupdater/src/SourceRepositoryTypes/GithubRepositoryType.php:114` builds `zipball_url` from hardcoded `GITHUB_API_URL = 'https://api.github.com'`; `:124` `downloadRelease($this->client, $release->zipball_url, $storageFile)`; `overrides/.../AbstractRepositoryType.php:100-109` `downloadRelease()` — plain Guzzle GET, no `verify=>false`, but also **no checksum/signature verification** of the downloaded zip before `unzipArchive()` (line 39) and `update()` (line 138) overwrite `app/`, `config/`, `vendor/`, `database/`, `routes/`, etc. Version-check calls go through a FreeScout-run proxy `github_api_url => 'https://freescout.net/github-api'` (`config/self-update.php:41`), but the actual code payload is fetched straight from `api.github.com`. |

fields.value: `overrides/codedge/laravel-selfupdater/src/SourceRepositoryTypes/GithubRepositoryType.php:114` builds `zipball_url` from hardcoded `GITHUB_API_URL = 'https://api.github.com'`; `:124` `downloadRelease($this->client, $release->zipball_url, $storageFile)`; `overrides/.../AbstractRepositoryType.php:100-109` `downloadRelease()` — plain Guzzle GET, no `verify=>false`, but also **no checksum/signature verification** of the downloaded zip before `unzipArchive()` (line 39) and `update()` (line 138) overwrite `app/`, `config/`, `vendor/`, `database/`, `routes/`, etc. Version-check calls go through a FreeScout-run proxy `github_api_url => 'https://freescout.net/github-api'` (`config/self-update.php:41`), but the actual code payload is fetched straight from `api.github.com`.
